scope: One bounded scratch candidate, two native full-scene views; no Site edits.

frames.finding: Skyline is less dominated by isolated cones, but broad white terraced bands across the far slopes are visibly unacceptable.
Opening view still contains obvious smooth bare sidewalls and a fine-grain texture transition at their bases. It does not demonstrate a credible distant forest or sufficiently rugged coastal relief.

seamAudit: All recorded CPU core, collar, perimeter and underwater checks pass; see seam-proof.json. This is not visual acceptance.
suspectedCause: Inference only: 20-80 m cuts and fractures are insufficiently supported by distant radial mesh intervals of 16/32/48 m; interpolated mesh normals and sharp material classification may amplify terracing.
possibleFollowup: Retain current evidence. Investigate geometry support relative to radial spacing and continuous-height finite-difference normals before another tightly scoped comparison. No followup candidate has been made.
limitations: Native ANGLE/Mesa Three.js rendering is real scene execution, but is not browser QA or consumer device performance evidence.
No photorealism or AAA-quality claim is supported.
